{{Quote|Our fathers fought hard against evil men like ''Kugg'' to free this land! It's time we fought ''again!''<nowiki />|The old man|<ref name="Droids 1" />}}
An '''old man'''<ref name="SW.com" /> lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dodz]].<ref name="Droids 1" /> In [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{DroidsComicDate}}</ref> the wizened [[Human/Legends|Human]] tried to encourage the [[Youngling/Legends|young]] [[Gender/Legends|boy]] [[Jost Ellon]] to fight back against the ruling [[Governor/Legends|governor]], [[Kugg]], who had been imposing heavy, unfair taxes; the man reminded Ellon that their ancestors had fought hard to free their land in the first place, so it was only right that they continued battling. The man also implored Ellon to follow his heart. The old man had [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] that included a full beard as well as light skin, sporting green [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] and shoes while carrying a [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] [[Staff/Legends|staff]].<ref name="Droids 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The old man appeared in the [[Droids (1986) 1|first issue]] of the [[Star Wars: Droids (1986)|''Star Wars: Droids'']] [[Star Wars comic books|comic series]], which was written by [[David Manak]], illustrated by [[John Romita Sr.]], and published by [[Marvel Comics]] in [[1986]].<ref name="Droids 1" />
